name: restaurant-location-production-readiness
title: Harden restaurant current-location capture for production
description: Persist browser geolocation into restaurant latitude/longitude, reverse-geocode the current position into restaurant address fields, validate the coordinate pair at frontend and backend boundaries, and cover the flow with focused tests.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Manual testing exposed stale address fields after GPS capture. The manager flow now reuses the existing reverse-geocode endpoint, replaces stale address components on success, and preserves coordinates plus the manual address on provider failure. GitHub Actions run 28818809602 passed frontend and backend lint/tests/build plus Playwright smoke tests. Real device address accuracy remains a manual check because it depends on upstream map coverage.
